## Working‑capital status for the “Big 4” U.S. airlines at the close of FY 2020

| Airline | Working capital (FY 2020, end 2020) | Positive/Negative |
|---------|-------------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Delta Air Lines, Inc.** | **≈ $2.5 billion** | **Positive** |
| **United Airlines Holdings, Inc.** | **≈ –$0.15 billion** | **Negative** |
| **American Airlines Group, Inc.** | **≈ $2.1 billion** | **Positive** |
| **Southwest Airlines Co.** | **≈ $2.8 billion** | **Positive** |

### Key take‑away
At the end of the 2020 fiscal year **only United Airlines Holdings reported negative working capital**.  
All three other “Big 4” carriers – Delta, American, and Southwest – maintained **positive working capital** in their 10‑K filings for 2020.
